data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve strengthening totaling GBP 4.1 million (2013: GBP 0.5m release).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 157.998m. The report records prior accident year reserve movements amounting to a net strengthening of GBP 4.1m (net of reinsurance). No gross prior-year movement figure was provided; the GBP 4.1m is disclosed as a net strengthening in the notes. The Managing Agent cites several large losses in 2014 and adverse prior year development as contributing factors; no specific named prior-year events or LOB-level prior-year adjustments are quantified.
raw_causal_phrases: prior accident year reserve strengthening totaling GBP 4.1 million (2013: GBP 0.5m release).
benefitted from the relatively benign catastrophe environment in 2014 with no significant catastrophe loss impact
did experience several large losses, particularly towards the end of 2014

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding). The report does not provide a GROSS 'movement in prior years' figure; only a net prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 4.1m is disclosed (used here as fallback and flagged). No claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement breakdown by LOB is provided. The 'Motor' gross premium is printed as '-' in the segmental table and treated as 0.0 in the mix.
